approach: I followed the DS-01 procedure in the data-science-steps skill. From feat.tasks I took the Data Science lane's tasks (TSK-03 and TSK-04, both in ap_forecast). From org.engineering_stack I took the language, CI command, coverage bar and branch convention, and the statement that no repository uses Databricks or a database. Step policy (G9) blocks shell commands in DS-01, so my git commands were refused. Instead I relied on the spine's tool:repo-access view for availability, the branch and write access. I backed it up by reading files in the checkout: .git/HEAD and refs/heads, __init__.py for the version and exports, ci.py for the CI gate, and the source and test layout. I wrote task.repo_access.md with the outcome. It also lists two non-blocking questions: whether the coverage package is installed on the runner, and whether the single branch feature/story is right for two stories.
